feed.18:
For years, Northwest Oregon has been treated like an afterthought.

When races are considered "unwinnable," investment disappears. Campaign support disappears. Candidates stop running.

Communities deserve better than that.

Northwest Oregon PAC exists because we believe every district deserves competition, every voter deserves a choice, and every community deserves someone willing to fight for it.

We're not waiting for someone else to invest in our region.

We're building it ourselves.
feed.19:
This PAC wasn't created to send resources somewhere else.

It was created to keep them here.

Every contribution, endorsement, and conversation helps strengthen Northwest Oregon, not just one candidate.

That's how lasting political infrastructure is built.

That's the future we're building.
feed.21:
Energy touches nearly every part of our daily lives, from heating our homes to keeping small businesses open.

Northwest Oregon PAC believes families shouldn't have to choose between managing monthly expenses and keeping the lights on. We support practical energy policies that prioritize affordability, reliability, and long-term resilience for our communities
feed.22:
Northwest Oregon's strength has always come from its ability to adapt.

Our communities have never relied on a single industry or a single solution. We believe the same approach should guide our energy future, supporting reliable infrastructure, encouraging innovation, and protecting affordability for the people and businesses that call this region home.

A resilient future starts with

balanced decisions. Share if you agree.
feed.23:
Every priority we champion begins with listening.

The issues facing Astoria aren't always the same as those in Hillsboro or Tillamook—but across Northwest Oregon, we hear common themes: affordability, opportunity, safety, accountability, and a desire for practical leadership.

That's why these five priorities guide everything we do.
feed.24:
Campaigns begin and end.

Communities don't.

That's why Northwest Oregon PAC was created with a long-term vision: to develop leaders, support competitive candidates, and strengthen civic participation throughout our region.

Success isn't measured only by Election Day.

It's measured by whether Northwest Oregon is stronger four years from now than it is today.

If you believe our region deserves long-term investment, not just election-season attention, follow along and be part of what's next.
